_meta.description: Synthetic competitor research for the Product Discovery Agent demo. Competitor names are fictional placeholders and do not represent real companies.

offer.implementation: System-aware dark theme with manual override, available on web and desktop apps.
Full dark theme including charts and data visualizations.
Dark theme available only on desktop, not yet on mobile.

differentiation_opportunities: Few competitors extend dark theming to data visualizations/charts - doing this well could be a differentiator.
Scheduled auto-switching (sunrise/sunset based) is not common among tracked competitors.

offer.implementation: Native iOS and Android apps with offline caching for core workflows.
Native Android app targeted at field/warehouse workers; iOS in beta.

differentiation_opportunities: No tracked competitor offers a lightweight approval-only mobile experience - a focused 'approvals and alerts' app could be a faster, lower-scope entry point than a full native rebuild.

offer.implementation: AI-generated call summaries with action item extraction, opt-in per call.
Automatic transcript plus summary emailed after every recorded call.

differentiation_opportunities: Competitors summarize generically; none tracked tie summaries back into structured follow-up tasks inside the product itself - closing that loop could be a differentiator.
Data-handling transparency (where transcripts are stored, retention period) is not clearly communicated by any tracked competitor - a clear privacy story could build trust.

offer.implementation: Interactive checklist with progress bar and in-app tooltips for first 7 days.
Guided setup wizard plus an assigned onboarding specialist for enterprise tier.
Template-based quick start reduces time-to-first-value for common use cases.

differentiation_opportunities: Most competitors gate guided onboarding behind enterprise pricing tiers - offering a lightweight self-serve checklist to all tiers could be a differentiator.
None tracked show setup progress relative to similar customers ('teams like yours typically finish step 3 in 2 days') - a benchmarking nudge could improve completion.

offer.implementation: One-click PDF export with company branding on every report.
PDF export available for select report types, not all.

differentiation_opportunities: Few competitors support scheduled/automated recurring PDF exports (e.g., emailed monthly) - this could reduce manual reporting work for customers.
